fields.meta_title: Employee Availability Form Builder for Shift Work | Emergent
fields.meta_description: Build an employee availability form from a prompt: a weekly shift grid, change requests, holiday sign-ups, and reminders. Free to start.
fields.h1: Build an Employee Availability Form for Every Shift
fields.hero_description: Build an employee availability form that collects the shifts each person can work and saves them to a database you own.
fields.features_heading: What the Form Asks, and Where the Answers Go
fields.features_subheading: A manager builds next week's schedule from the availability on file. These six pieces keep that file current and sortable by shift.
fields.feature_1:
A grid built around your real shifts

Describe the shifts you run, such as open, mid, and close. Emergent builds a day-by-shift grid, staff tick the ones they can work, and each answer is saved as a row you can filter.
fields.feature_2:
Hours wanted, with a floor and a ceiling

Ask how many hours each person wants a week, from a minimum to a maximum. A manager can see that a part-timer capped the week at 20 hours before offering a sixth shift.
fields.feature_3:
Notes for what a checkbox cannot hold

A short text field holds what a grid misses, such as a class that ends at 4:30 or a bus that only runs on weekdays. Each note stays in the same row as that person's grid answers.
fields.feature_4:
One question per screen on a phone

Staff answer on a phone between shifts, one question per screen, instead of looking for the clipboard in the back office. Each submission lands in the table once they tap Send.
fields.feature_5:
Availability your scheduling tool can read

Connect the availability table to any scheduling or payroll tool with an API, so the hours staff enter are the hours the scheduler sees, with nothing retyped from paper.
fields.feature_6:
The form's code in your GitHub repository

On paid plans, export the full code to your GitHub repository. A developer can add a location or a shift type in code, then host the form on your own servers and keep building.

fields.usecase_heading: Four Forms Behind a Full Schedule
fields.tab_content_1:
Friday dinner: 6 cooks free, all in one view

Saltgrass Kitchen builds its schedule from one table. Line cook Teodora Lind marks Monday to Thursday evenings and Saturday lunch on the weekly grid, and her answers save as one row. Kitchen manager Wes Calder filters the table for Friday dinner, and 6 cooks come up. He fills the line from that list.
fields.tab_content_2:
From September 2, evenings only, once Gus approves

Ines Pruitt starts fall classes in September. She asks Marlow Street Pharmacy to move her to evenings only from September 2 and notes that her last class ends at 3:15. The request reaches store manager Gus Ferrante in Slack. Until he approves, her current hours stay on the table and the schedule follows them.
fields.tab_content_3:
On December 24, 3 people can work and 4 are needed

Fernhill Outfitters needs 4 people on the floor every day the store opens in December. The holiday sign-up lists each date for staff to check off. Any date with fewer than 4 people sends store manager Lena Okafor an email. Only 3 can work December 24, and that date is the one waiting in her inbox.
fields.tab_content_4:
By Tuesday, 3 of 17 baristas still owe their hours

Bramble and Pine Coffee posts its schedule every other Thursday for its 17 baristas. On the Tuesday before, the app checks who has confirmed their availability for the next schedule, and 14 have. The other 3 get an email reminder with a link back to the form, and their rows read Pending until they answer.

fields.howto_title: How to Create an Employee Availability Form
fields.howto_description: Seven steps to create an employee availability form that matches your real shifts and sends each change to a manager.
fields.howto_step_2_title: 02 Set a notice period for changes
fields.howto_step_1_des: Write down every shift you staff in a normal week, with its start time, such as an 11:00 AM lunch and a 4:00 PM dinner. The grid on the form uses those same blocks, so the answers you collect line up with the schedule you build.
fields.howto_step_2_des: Pick how much notice a change needs, such as 2 weeks, and print it on the form beside the start date. A request that starts sooner can still go through, but the manager sees right away that it is short notice.
fields.howto_step_3_des: Leave pay, performance, and home address off this form, since other records already hold them. Ask who is answering, which shifts they can work, the hours they want, and any note, and staff finish it in a couple of minutes.
fields.howto_step_4_des: Send change requests to the manager of that location and short-staffed dates to whoever writes the schedule. Choose between a Slack message and an email for each, and name a backup for the days that manager is off.
fields.howto_step_5_des: Put the shifts, the notice period, and the routing into one prompt. Emergent builds the employee availability form, the table behind it, and the alerts. When a shift or a rule changes later, ask for the change in plain English.
fields.howto_step_6_title: 06 Keep old answers with an end date
fields.howto_step_6_des: When someone changes their availability, end the old row on the day the new one starts instead of overwriting it. A manager asking why a March shift went unfilled can then see what that person had offered at the time.
fields.howto_step_7_title: 07 Run a test week with real staff
fields.howto_step_7_des: Ask two staff members to fill it out on their phones, one of them with a change request. Check that both rows land in the table, then filter for one shift and confirm the right names come back.

faq_plan.q: What is an employee availability form?
faq_plan.a: An employee availability form is where staff record the days and shifts they can work, along with the hours they want each week. Managers build the schedule from those answers instead of guessing who is free.

faq_plan.q: How do I create an employee availability form?
faq_plan.a: List the shifts you schedule, the notice a change needs, and who approves changes. Put all of it in one prompt to Emergent's AI form builder. You get the form and the table behind it, ready for staff to fill out on a phone.

faq_plan.q: What should a work availability form include?
faq_plan.a: Include the employee's name and role, a grid of days by shift, and a weekly hours target. Add the date the answers start and a yes or no on being called in at short notice. A work availability form that stops there takes a couple of minutes to finish.

faq_plan.q: How do I adapt an employee availability form template to my shifts?
faq_plan.a: Replace the generic morning and evening columns in an employee availability form template with the shifts you run. Then cut questions about pay or contact details. Those belong on an employee information form, which changes far less often than availability does.

faq_plan.q: Can I make a free employee availability form online?
faq_plan.a: Yes. Describe a free employee availability form to Emergent, publish it, and send staff the link. The free tier covers building and publishing, and every answer is saved to a database you own with no response caps.

faq_plan.q: How often should staff fill out a new availability form?
faq_plan.a: Ask for a new one each season and whenever someone's week changes, such as a new semester or a second job. Between those, a short confirmation before each schedule posts keeps old answers current. Keep past employee availability forms with their end dates rather than deleting them.

faq_plan.q: Should an availability form ask about reliability or attendance?
faq_plan.a: No. Keep the form to when someone can work and how many hours they want. Attendance and reliability belong in an employee evaluation form, where a manager can add context. Keeping the two apart lets a person mark Sundays off without wondering how it reads on their review.

faq_plan.q: How do I set up an availability form for rotating shifts?
faq_plan.a: Ask for availability by shift type rather than by date, such as day or night, and add a question on how many weeks in a row someone can work nights. Build each rotation from the people who said yes to that block, then check it against the hours they asked for.

faq_plan.q: Can employees fill out an availability form on their phone?
faq_plan.a: Yes. Instead of printing an employee availability form PDF and handing it back, staff answer on the phone they already carry. Emergent can build it as one question per screen, and each answer lands in the table the manager filters.

faq_plan.q: How should an availability form handle schedule conflicts?
faq_plan.a: Give staff a way to flag a conflict from the same form, tied to the shift and the availability they submitted. The manager sees both side by side and can move the shift. Set a cutoff for flags, such as two days before the shift, and handle anything later in person.
